name: dmf_crt_bus
purpose: Exact CRT bus for a system of periodic processes: clock lane (RNS), GF(2)/GF(3) field lanes (Z6), unified Golay x XQR23 code, module selection.
verified_invariants: phase(encode(t), p) == t % p for p in {22,33,24,46,759,1081}; range 285384
MI(clock a, clock b) over a joint period == log2 gcd(a,b)
single-channel errors corrected for all residues (channels 8,3,11,23,47 + 53,59)
Golay[24,12,8] and XQR23[24,12,9] both preserved by P23, P11, S (S signed on GF(3))
signed symmetry group order 12144 = 2*6072; lane orders include (22,11),(24,12),(46,23)
joint decode: 3 GF(2)-lane + 4 GF(3)-lane errors at independent positions
choose_moduli reproduces (3,8,11,23,47)+(53,59) from the six target periods; matches brute force
assumptions: ternary Floquet generators are an assumed realization (period 33, base order 11)
tests: python3 run_checks.py (50 tests; 2 optional cross-checks need an external reference tree via DMF_TRUTH_PATH)
